dict.string:
The user typed a request to find a movie or TV series. It may be in Russian or English, may contain typos, partial titles, actor names, or a description of the plot.
If the request came from voice, Russian titles may appear as a rough English transcription (for example "brat two" may mean "Брат 2").
User request: ￼
Identify up to 3 titles the user most likely means, most likely first. Return a dictionary with key "candidates": a list of up to 3 dictionaries, each with: - "title_en": official English title (string) - "title_ru": official Russian release title (string; transliterate or translate if no official one) - "year": release year of the first release (number) - "type": exactly one of: movie, tv_show, animation, animated_series, anime, documentary - "genres": list of 1 to 4 genres, chosen ONLY from this list: ￼ - "confidence": exactly one of: high, medium, low
Use "high" only if the request unambiguously identifies one title. If you do not recognize the title at all, return your best guess of the English and Russian title with confidence "low"; the title may be newer than your knowledge. Do not invent extra keys.
